current_role: 50th Vice President of the United States (since January 20, 2025)
summary: JD Vance, a Marine veteran and Yale Law graduate, became known for his 2016 memoir Hillbilly Elegy, worked for Peter Thiel's Mithril Capital, and won Ohio's Senate seat in 2022 with $15 million in super PAC backing from Thiel. Trump chose him as his 2024 running mate; he took office as vice president in January 2025. Rubio has said he would back Vance for the 2028 nomination, though the Republicans' November 2026 midterm losses raised doubts about his standing.
